Standard Engineering to acquire majority stake in GScale Energy

Standard Engineering has announced plans to acquire a 51% stake in GScale Energy for ₹190 crore. This move signifies Standard Engineering's entry into the AI data-centre infrastructure market. The acquisition is part of a larger ₹500 crore program aimed at growth and capacity expansion in this sector.
